summary: Frontend-only test of Bulk Move Items To Another List, the Import column picker and re-importing our own Excel exports. Tested with Playwright at 390px as Pro skipper test_session_pro_1 and as crew test_session_free_1. Test data: 2 cloned checklists, 4 imported lists from /tmp/imp/BM.xlsx (built by make3.py) and 4 re-imported exports (Ground Tackle, Sail Loft, a checklist and a custom list). WORKING: (1) Bulk move UI. The button sits below move-area-section and the target defaults to My To Do List. Unticking a heading unticks its sub-items and ticking it re-ticks them. A sub-item can be unticked on its own. Select All shows the right N of N. Cancel works. Both rename-list-error messages work. Crew can't open the Edit List Panel. (2) Saving the move: checklist -> checklist keeps the order, and an orphan sub-item arrives un-indented. Rename in the same Save still applies. The toast reads 'N items moved to X' and Undo restores both lists. Moving everything leaves the source empty with the empty state showing and no crash. Maintenance/imported -> checklist gives 'Desc - Brand: .., Length: .., Cost: 120 USD' labels with headings kept as headings. Imported -> custom maps attributes by name. An orphan into an empty maintenance list creates the 'Moved items' category. Anything -> Boat Budget adds rows with the product details, and Undo works. (3) Import: every column has a type select with @desc/@cat/@skip, and only one desc/cat column is allowed at a time. Picking a different description column changes the preview names. Category/Group/Description/Item/Heading/Due date from/Last service/Service due/Cost/'X unit' are recognised. Category-only rows become categories and carry the next_service_date. Checklist export headings become categories, and Ticked/Flagged/Boat area come in as Text. Plain import uses the first column and the tab name, and the zero row is skipped. (4) Single-item Move to another list still works. FAILED: 4 issues. (a) Units are lost on re-import for anything except Cost. (b) Plain checklist items become categories in a maintenance target. (c) Moving to a boat area and bulk moving in the same Save loses the area change. (d) The target list includes special list types (YouTube, Movies, MPA, Bartender, Meal Plan, Ship's Log), which gives broken items. All TEST data was removed through the UI. GET /api/me/boat matches the baseline exactly (registry 34=34, no data differences).

ui_bugs.issue: '<Attr> unit' columns are detected (import-unit shows 'Unit of Weight'), but the value column they belong to defaults to Text ('char'). valueOf only applies unitCol to integer/decimal types, so units and '(est.)' are silently dropped. Repro: export Ground Tackle and re-import it. 'Weight 16 / Weight unit kg (est.)' was stored as {weight:'16'} with no __unit and no __est. The same happens for Length, Diameter, Sail area, Luff length, Age and Chain length. Only Cost works, because 'Cost' is guessed as 'decimal cost'. This fails the spec item ''<Attr> unit' values (incl. (est.)) become that attribute's unit/estimate'.

A plain top-level checklist item that is not a heading (it has no sub-items) arrives as a CATEGORY in the maintenance target, because its indent is false. Repro: the orphan 'Hatches closed' in TEST_CL2 had been un-indented after an earlier move. Moving it to TEST_Dst stored it as a category with no indent. The spec says items without a moved heading should go under the target's last category or a new 'Moved items' category. Fix: when the target is MAINT_KIND, only treat a top-level item as a category if it is a heading (childrenOf(...).length > 0). Otherwise set indent true, and add the 'Moved items' head if needed.

ui_bugs.component: BoatPrep.renameList (move-area + bulk move in the same Save)
ui_bugs.issue: If a boat area is chosen in move-area-section AND a bulk move is set up in the same Save, the area change is lost. The toast '5 items moved to TEST_Port Locker' still shows, but no item keeps its area. Cause: setItems(area) runs first, then bulkMoveItems builds moved.source/target from the stale data[from] snapshot and mutate overwrites it. Fix: compute the bulk move inside the mutate callback from s.data, or apply the area to sourceItems before calling bulkMove. Or allow only one of the two per Save.

bulk-move-target-select lists every registry list, including special kinds: TEST_My YT (youtube), TEST_My Movies (movies), MPA Shopping List (mpa), Magic Bartender Cocktails (bartender), Meal Plan and Ship's Log. Moving a checklist item into a YouTube list stored {label:'2. Cabin'} and showed a blank channel card with no name or link. Fix: filter targets to checklist, MAINT_KIND and BUDGET_KIND lists, and exclude MEDIA_KINDS, mpa, bartender, meal plan and log lists.

issues: Category/heading rows (e.g. 'Plain') become meaningless budget rows with no cost. Consider skipping headings when the target is the budget.

action_items: HIGH: in guessRoles, a column that has a matching '<name> unit' column should default to a number type (infer it from the unit: kg/lb -> decimal weight, m/ft -> decimal length, m²/ft² -> decimal area, 'years old' -> integer age, otherwise decimal). Alternatively, make valueOf keep the unit/est for char columns. Then re-test the Ground Tackle and Sail Loft re-imports.
MEDIUM: in bulkMove into a maintenance list, non-heading top-level checklist items must become items (indent:true) under the last category or 'Moved items', not categories.
MEDIUM: renameList: build the bulk move from the latest state (inside mutate) so a boat-area move in the same Save isn't overwritten. Or block using both at once.
MEDIUM: limit bulk-move targets to compatible lists (checklists, maintenance/custom/imported, Boat Budget). Exclude youtube/movies/mpa/bartender/meal plan/ship's log.

LOW: an orphan sub-item whose heading stays behind lands under the previous moved heading in the target (e.g. 'Hatches closed' from '2. Cabin' ended up under '1. Deck'). Consider grouping orphans under 'Moved items'.

LOW: re-imported 'Due date from = Category' items get their own copy of the due date, so they no longer inherit from the category. Consider skipping the item due date when 'Due date from' is 'Category'.
LOW: Import lets the user leave no 'Use as item description' column (by changing the desc column to Text). Items then silently become 'Row N'. Warn, or block Preview.
critical_code_review_comments: bulkMove.js line 33: `indent = item.indent ? headMoved || target.kind === MAINT_KIND : false` gives plain top-level items indent=false in maintenance targets, so they become categories.

BoatPrep.bulkMoveItems uses the render-time `data` snapshot for both source and target. Any setItems in the same tick (the area move) is lost. Undo also restores a snapshot, which is the accepted pattern elsewhere.
sheetImport.valueOf: unitCol is ignored for char/date/picklist types, but guessRoles defaults every non-cost value column to 'char'.
BoatPrep line 827 hides lists using `state.list_hidden`, while MoveItemDialog uses `hiddenLists`. They are the same value for skippers, but use one consistently.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (31 of 36 checks passed; 4 functional defects + 1 design note)
